topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
subtopic: Acquired Fund Fees and Funds of Funds
source_evidence: if your fund owns shares of another fund, you are paying the fees and expenses of your fund and indirectly paying the fees and expenses of the underlying fund.
question: What are Acquired Fund Fees and Expenses, and why might they appear in a fund of funds’ prospectus fee table?
answer: Acquired Fund Fees and Expenses represent fees and expenses charged by underlying funds whose shares your fund owns. In a fund of funds, you pay the expenses of your fund and indirectly bear the expenses of those underlying funds, so the acquired fund expenses are shown in the prospectus fee table.
